bullets: Injury & Practice Status: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), WR Tai Felton (hip), and WR Myles Price (knee) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [Warren Ludford](https://www.dailynorseman.com/minnesota-vikings-injuries/102092/vikings-falcons-first-injury-report). WR Jordan Addison (thumb), CB Isaiah Rodgers (quadriceps), and S Harrison Smith (thigh) did not practice Wednesday [vikings.com Official](https://www.vikings.com/news/falcons-injury-report-week-12-2026-nfl-season).

Week 12 Falcons Outlook: Kevin O'Connell and DC Brian Flores open installation for the Atlanta Falcons (3-7, MIN -7, HC Kevin Stefanski, OC Tommy Rees & DC Jeff Ulbrich (U.S. Bank Stadium))—a unit ranked #3 in Rush EPA Allowed / Gm (-1.81) as Minnesota prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873084) [Ben Goessling](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4429205/jordan-addison#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Kevin%20O'Connell%20said%20Addison%20will).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 7-3 (3rd in NFC North • #6 Seed in NFC), Minnesota carries a 88% postseason projection, 27.6% NFC North division title mark, and 5.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-micah-parsons-jordan-addison-lions-packers-vikings/).

Around the Beat: The Vikings held a walk-through on Wednesday, so their practice report is an estimation, but Kyler Murray returned in a limited fashion [Ben Goessling](https://bsky.app/profile/bengoessling.bsky.social/post/3n36as7rzwe2p).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Minnesota ranks #28 in Points / Game (18.6), #1 in Points Allowed / Game (16.1), #5 in Turnover Differential (+6), giving Kevin O'Connell and Brian Flores a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Atlanta Falcons [Kevin Seifert](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50584512/minnesota-vikings-kirk-cousins-flores-defense).
